name: valdi-kitchen-sink
description: Comprehensive Valdi framework demonstration app showcasing all core features

scripts.help:
echo '
📱 Valdi Kitchen Sink - Available Commands:

  npm run build        - Build iOS app
  npm run dev          - Build and install to simulator
  npm run test:ios     - Install to iOS Simulator
  npm run verify       - Run build verification
  npm run clean        - Clean build artifacts
  npm run clean:deep   - Deep clean (removes cache)
  npm run simulators   - List available iOS Simulators
  npm run lint         - Run ESLint
  npm run lint:fix     - Fix ESLint errors

For more details, see WORKFLOW.md
'
